leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a TypeScript interface to define the structure of a typed pub/sub bus.
Construct a class that initializes and manages typed event subscriptions.
Apply generic type parameters to create type-safe publish and subscribe methods.
Manipulate internal data structures to store and retrieve typed event handlers.
Integrate the pub/sub bus into a simple TypeScript module for testing.
Control the flow of typed events by publishing data to specific subscribers.
Configure the bus to handle multiple event types with distinct payloads.
